$comment: TOOLCHAIN-BOOTSTRAP.md §1. A second run reads this and asks nothing. Every value was verified against the machine during the §2 preflight probe; `verified` records what was actually observed, `answer` what the toolchain is pinned to.

php.note: php_local 8.5 was requested but Herd has no php85 binary and permissions forbid global installs. ^8.4 already admits 8.5, so nothing in the toolchain changes. Recorded in §11.

make.note: macOS stock. No .ONESHELL, no $(file ...) used anywhere.

awk.note: printf %-*s and match()/substr() empirically verified before the help block was written.

static_analysis.baseline: none - greenfield, a day-one baseline is @ts-ignore at scale

database.integration: mysql - local 127.0.0.1:3306 when DB env is present, CI service container mysql:8.4 otherwise
database.note: Local Homebrew MySQL is 9.5.0; CI pins 8.4 because production is 8.4. The laptop is not the reference.

decisions.pest_5_over_4: php_constraint ^8.4 is exactly Pest 5's floor. Pinning Pest 4 would buy PHP 8.3 compatibility that the constraint already gave up. Pest 5.1.4 -> PHPUnit ^13.3; Laravel 13.31 tests against PHPUnit ^13.0.3.
decisions.integration_db: `make test` is SQLite :memory: and always runs. `make integration` targets MySQL and fails loudly when no database is reachable - it never skips, because a skip reads exactly like a pass.
decisions.template_scope: One conventions slice with empty bodies: layout + partials + component, SCSS token/BEM architecture, and Model/Migration/Factory/Seeder/Controller/FormRequest/Policy/Resource plus matching Pest tests. Configuration is complete; domain logic is absent.
decisions.branching: main is always deployable and nobody commits to it directly; develop is the integration branch; work happens on feature/<name> branches cut from develop. Documented in docs/branching.md.
decisions.windows_is_wsl2: Native Windows was tried and measured on a windows-latest runner: the chocolatey make spawns cmd.exe per recipe line and silently ignores a POSIX SHELL it cannot resolve, so the gates never ran. WSL2 is Linux, so the toolchain needs no special case at all.
decisions.ci_is_ubuntu_only: One runner OS. It saves Actions minutes, make is native there, and a second OS was buying a platform nobody on this project develops on.
